questions_and_answers.question: And the Harrises, how did they make out?

answers.text: Y a los Harris, ¿cómo les fue?

questions_and_answers.question: I left them at their house.
How did the city strike Mrs. Harris?

answers.text: ¿Qué le pareció la ciudad a la señora Harris?

questions_and_answers.question: She liked it a lot, but she got nervous with the traffic and the noise.

answers.text: Le gustó mucho, pero se puso nerviosa con el tráfico y el ruido.

questions_and_answers.question: The same thing happened to me when I arrived last month.

answers.text: A mí me pasó lo mismo cuando llegué el mes pasado.

questions_and_answers.question: I’m beginning to get used to everything.
By the way, that one the other day turned out fantastic, didn’t it?

answers.text: A propósito. La del otro día resultó fantástica, ¿no?

questions_and_answers.question: At least we enjoyed ourselves thoroughly.

answers.text: Por lo menos nos divertimos mucho.

questions_and_answers.question: You all didn’t miss dancing a single number.

answers.text: Ustedes no dejaron de bailar ni una pieza.

questions_and_answers.question: We were the last to leave.
